# LibMP

Unmodified Roblox LibMP release downloaded from
https://github.com/Roblox/libmp/releases/download/latest/LibMP.luau on 2026-09-19.

Upstream: https://github.com/Roblox/libmp

Downloaded SHA-256: `AB9579E592E8751386A01537152F2B739CC7942CE565D3C11337CDDAA250D231`.
The downloaded file uses CRLF; Studio normalizes source line endings.
Library version reported by the Studio bundle at development time: 65536.

The library is included to support published clients and servers. Updating it
requires rerunning the diagnostic integration tests and recording the new hash.
Keep it separate from authored core files; its generated code is intentionally large.
